features.body: Draft a schedule from the available demand, roles and availability. Managers review and refine the proposal before publishing.
Review availability, qualification, clashes and overtime warnings while you build. Check the required settings and resolve issues before publishing.

scheduling.creamLede: Staff can find their next shift and request a change from their phone. Managers review coverage and approvals in the same scheduling workflow.

features.body: Use configured location checks to help verify where a clock-in is made. Review exceptions and device requirements during setup.
Use supported device verification to help confirm who is clocking in. Check the device and verification requirements for your team.

features.title: Breaks recorded for review
features.body: Staff record or confirm breaks so managers can review the timesheet against the applicable policy.
Approved hours can feed the configured payroll workflow. Review overtime rules and exceptions before finalizing the run.

howSteps.body: Staff record or confirm breaks, then managers review any missing or disputed entries.
Managers correct exceptions and approve the hours for the configured payroll process.

attendance.loopLine: Attendance records contribute to workforce review alongside schedules and sales. Check sync status and data coverage before acting.

payroll.featuresTitle: Calculate, review and prepare the handoff.
payroll.featuresDescription: Use versioned country rules to calculate a pay run and prepare supported outputs. Confirm your required jurisdiction, forms and provider path during setup.

features.body: Review the supported country and regional rules for your operation, including the US, Canada, UK, EU and GCC. Confirm local requirements and available outputs before rollout.
Calculate the run and prepare supported payslips, filing outputs and bank files. Your team checks the results and submits through the agreed provider or process.

features.title: Review required year-end outputs
features.body: Confirm which annual forms your country configuration supports and how the team will review and submit them.
Review the export and field requirements of the payroll provider you keep. Agree the handoff and responsibilities before the first run.
Bring approved hours into the configured payroll workflow. Review rates, overtime rules and any exceptions before finalizing.
Review the calculated run, explanation and audit record before approval. Resolve missing setup or rule issues before handing it off.

howSteps.body: Configured country rules calculate the run and prepare supported payslips and output files. Review rule versions and exceptions.

howSteps.title: Approve and hand off
howSteps.body: Your team reviews and approves the run, then uses the agreed payment, provider and filing process. Calculation and export are separate from disbursement and submission.

payroll.loopLine: Payroll records and overtime trends contribute cost context to workforce analysis, according to the configured sources.

payroll.ctaDescription: Bring your countries and provider requirements. Review a sample calculation, the supported outputs and the approval and handoff steps.

features.body: Coordinate onboarding, employee changes and offboarding on the employee record. Review the required checks and payroll steps for your operation.
Keep documents and signatures with the employee record, with reminders for configured expiry dates.

people.loopLine: Relevant workforce records contribute context to labor analysis according to the capabilities and sources in your setup.
people.creamLede: Keep people records alongside the workforce work they support. Managers and HR use the same context while role permissions control access.
people.ctaDescription: Review an employee’s onboarding, documents, leave and offboarding, with the access and package scope your team needs.

features.body: Use no-show and turnover signals to decide where to investigate or speak with a manager. A risk score is an estimate, not a prediction about an individual.

faq.overview: Sundae is an operations management platform for hospitality and food-service. Core connects operating data with analysis, recommendations and result review. Crew supports workforce and daily work, including scheduling, attendance, tasks, handovers, people records and payroll. Choose Core, Crew or both according to your needs.
faq.start: Start with the work or question you need to improve. Explore Core, Crew or both in the pricing calculator at pricing.sundae.io, or book a walkthrough using your operation or a sample. The diagnostic is another way to organize a performance question.
faq.noFree: Sundae packages are paid. Book a walkthrough to review the relevant capabilities and discuss your operation before choosing a package. Your own data is optional.
